metadata.name: raid-maintain
metadata.description: Maintain the RAID log by classifying risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies from delivery signals. Autonomous for internal memory only.

kind.template: Collect blockers, missed dates, explicit assumptions, external dependencies, and stakeholder concerns.
Risk might happen; issue has happened; dependency is external blocker; assumption is unverified premise. Calibrate severity from impact and date proximity.

kind.instruction: Append new entries to memory.raid_log with source_url and mitigation. Do not send outbound.
